name: Surveyor 3
intro: Surveyor 3 reporting! This time I carry a little claw to dig trenches.
Fun secret: my engines will not shut off in time and I will bounce... twice.
Two and a half years from now, Apollo 12 astronauts will visit me and take some of my parts home!
Pick a good spot, so they can find me later.
briefing: We aim for the eastern Oceanus Procellarum.
Choose where I land: daylight and a good view of Earth, please.
fact: Apollo 12 landed just 180 m from Surveyor 3 and brought its camera back to Earth.
